description: This file defines an Android activity class named 'Animation' that demonstrates various activity transition animations, including fading, zooming, scaling, and thumbnail animations, with support for modern (API >= 16) and legacy devices.

classes.name: Animation
classes.description: An Android activity class that demonstrates different transition animations when moving between activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, and assigns click listeners for various animation options.

methods.name: onEnterAnimationComplete
methods.description: Logs a message when the enter animation completes.

methods.name: mFadeListener
methods.description: Click listener that initiates a fade animation transition to AlertDialogSamples activity.

methods.name: mZoomListener
methods.description: Click listener that initiates a zoom-in animation transition to AlertDialogSamples activity.

methods.name: mModernFadeListener
methods.description: Click listener that initiates a custom fade animation for modern devices.

methods.name: mModernZoomListener
methods.description: Click listener that initiates a custom zoom animation for modern devices.

methods.name: mScaleUpListener
methods.description: Click listener that scales up from the pressed view to animate transition.

methods.name: mZoomThumbnailListener
methods.description: Click listener that creates a thumbnail zoom animation for transition.

methods.name: mNoAnimationListener
methods.description: Click listener that transitions without animation.
